title: Platform Settings
subtitle: Configure global platform parameters, integrations, and default security policies
telegramContactHelp: Users contact this Telegram account to get shop accounts created.
telegramBotDesc: Used for platform-level notifications. Each shop configures its own bot token and chat ID in the Shop Dashboard.
botTokenHelp: Tokens are stored securely on the server and never exposed in the frontend bundle.

shop.title: Shop Settings
shop.subtitle: Configure your storefront identity, operational hours, POS receipts, and theme preferences.

brandAssets.title: Shop Brand Assets
brandAssets.description: Upload your official shop logo and promotional cover banner.
brandAssets.bannerHint: Appears at the top of your Telegram Mini App & Storefront

general.usernameHint: Unique handle for your public URL. Contact support to modify.
general.bioPlaceholder: e.g. Freshly roasted artisan coffee & bakery in BKK1
general.bioHint: Visible under your shop header and in social previews.
general.descriptionPlaceholder: Provide full details about your store, specialty products, or brand story...

operations.title: Operational Status
operations.description: Control whether your online storefront accepts live customer orders.
operations.pauseNotice: Turn this off if you need to pause new incoming orders for stocktaking or vacation.
operations.maintenancePlaceholder: e.g. We are currently closed for restock
operations.hoursDescription: Customers will see whether you are open based on these times.

pos.currencyDescription: Configure default operational currency and KHR exchange rate for KHQR payments.
pos.baseCurrencyHint: Primary currency for product pricing & sales.
pos.exchangeRateHint: Used on POS receipts and Bakong KHQR conversion.
pos.serviceChargeHint: Optional dine-in service fee for restaurants/cafes.
pos.receiptDescription: Customize the header, footer, and Wi-Fi credentials printed on customer receipts.
pos.printKhqrHint: Allows customers to scan and pay directly on paper receipt.
pos.printCashierHint: Shows which staff member processed the bill.

theme.paletteDescription: Tailor your storefront and mini app brand identity with curated palettes.
theme.slideshowDescription: Upload promotional slider banners for your customer storefront.
theme.slideshowHint: Add eye-catching seasonal promotions or daily specials.

social.title: Social Media & Contacts
social.description: Provide direct links so customers can easily contact you on Telegram, Facebook, and more.

security.title: Change Shop Account Password
security.description: Ensure your account stays secure by using a strong combination of characters.

preview.sampleTagline: Your store tagline and brief intro appear here.

toast.fillPassword: Please fill in all password fields
toast.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters

themeAndColorSub: Choose from 12+ curated full-system design templates or customize sidebar, navbar, and primary accents with 100% flexibility.
soundPrefSub: Play subtle click sounds on buttons, notifications, and interaction events.
resetModalSub: Are you sure you want to reset all appearance preferences to defaults?
resetModalBody: All custom colors, font sizes, sidebar panel positions, and dashboard widgets will be restored to their original factory defaults.
panelsSubtitle: Choose pre-built templates for your sidebar and navigation bar or customize dimensions and colors

customColorOverridesDesc: Manually adjust individual background, text, and border hex codes
